title: About me
intro: I'm Karan Sharma, a backend-focused full-stack engineer with 4+ years of experience building production web applications, who goes by rootz491 online.
bio: I enjoy designing systems that scale—from APIs and databases to Docker deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. Most of my work involves taking products from early prototypes to production, with a strong focus on performance, maintainability, and developer experience.

I've worked extensively with NestJS, Next.js, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, Redis, and modern DevOps tooling, and I'm particularly interested in AI-powered applications, distributed systems, and search infrastructure.
highlights: Designed full-stack systems from API to deployment
Production experience across Docker, CI/CD & cloud
